description: This file contains core functions for the PTM driver specific to the Danube platform, including hardware initialization, firmware download, and control functions for the PP32 processor.

methods.name: init_pmu
methods.description: Initializes the Power Management Unit by enabling specific modules.

methods.name: uninit_pmu
methods.description: Disables the Power Management Unit modules.

methods.name: reset_ppe
methods.description: Resets the PPE component; implementation is platform-specific and currently commented out.

methods.name: init_ema
methods.description: Configures the EMA share buffer settings.

methods.name: pp32_download_code
methods.description: Downloads firmware binary code and data to the PP32 processor.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_init_chip
methods.description: Performs hardware initialization for the PTM chip.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_uninit_chip
methods.description: Performs cleanup for the PTM chip.

methods.name: ifx_pp32_start
methods.description: Starts the PP32 processor after downloading firmware.
